caption:
Every overthinker needs to watch this 
#healthybodyhealthymind #wellness #wellnessjourney #newyork
transcript: People who overthink everything, they're not overthinking just because they're anxious. They're overthinking because their mind was trained to look for danger before it ever learned how to feel safe. People like this think about every possibility, every outcome, every little change in energy. Not because they want problems, but because being blindsided feels terrifying to them. A lot of people who overthink are carrying old pain, pain from betrayal, pain from disappointment, pain from trusting the wrong people. So now their mind stays alert all the time, always preparing, always scanning, always asking themselves what could go wrong next. And sometimes, deep down, they do not fully trust their ability to handle pain when it comes. So they try to predict everything before it happens. If you love someone like this, do not play games with them. Do not hide your intentions. Do not leave them confused. Be honest. Be direct. Be clear with your words. Because honesty brings peace to people whose minds are constantly preparing for chaos. And if you leave them alone with silence, their mind will create answers that were never even real. I know this because I used to be the same way. Overthinking everything, preparing for storms that never came. But eventually, I learned something important. Peace does not come from controlling every outcome. Peace comes from trusting yourself enough to handle whatever life brings. If this spoke to you, my e-book in the link on my profile may help you find a little more peace within yourself.
